items.quote: Two overlapping engine calls in one process that use the same Cozo graph namespace never return an unstructured 500 caused by 'RocksDB error: IO error: lock hold by current process'.

When constructing any store in _build_stores fails (for example the graph open raising under the lock in STOR-01), every store already opened in that call (kv, vector) is finalized before the exception leaves the engine method.
POST /evidence/resolve opens only the vector namespace named in the EvidenceRef.
GET /health is read-only and reports store state accurately.
Capability scoping is enforced per access mode.
An ingest whose wiring records any node failure commits nothing.
delete_document builds its stores with the resolved wiring's store_namespaces.
Opening a FaissVectorStore whose directory holds vector.faiss without vector.meta.json, or vector.meta.json without vector.faiss, raises VectorStoreCorruptedError, as the module docstring states.
